note: The module's only configuration is simple_pass_reset.settings:login_redirection (string, install default '/user'). Medium/hard cases read/write that single config key on the live site; reset/cleanup restore the shipped default '/user' explicitly. Easy cases cover the route override, permission, and settings key.

evals.prompt: In the simple_pass_reset module, which configuration setting controls where a user is redirected after they reset their password and are logged in, and what is its default value?
evals.expected_output: simple_pass_reset.settings:login_redirection controls the post-reset redirect; it defaults to /user.

evals.prompt: Where is the simple_pass_reset settings form, and which permission is required to access it?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/people/accounts/simple_pass_reset (route simple_pass_reset.admin_settings), gated by the 'administer simple pass reset' permission.

evals.prompt: How does simple_pass_reset change the standard Drupal password-reset experience? Which core route does it override to skip the extra one-time-login page?
evals.expected_output: A RouteSubscriber overrides the core user.reset route so its controller/title become 'Choose a new password' and it uses a custom access check; the user lands directly on the set-password form and is logged in on submit, skipping the intermediate one-time-login page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the simple_pass_reset configuration and tell me where a user is redirected after completing a password reset.
On this Drupal site, the simple_pass_reset post-password-reset redirect has been customised. Inspect the live configuration and state the exact path users are sent to.
On this Drupal site, configure simple_pass_reset so that after resetting their password users are redirected to /dashboard. Apply the change to the live configuration.

On this Drupal site, make simple_pass_reset send users to the site's front page after they reset their password. Apply the change to the live configuration. (In this module the front page is stored as the path '/'.)
evals.expected_output: simple_pass_reset.settings:login_redirection is set to '/' (the front page; entering <front> in the settings form stores '/').
